newsitem.title: USA: UNR Industries in talks to sell unit.
newsitem.headline: UNR Industries in talks to sell unit.

text.p: UNR Industries Inc said on Thursday it is negotiating to sell its Real Time Solutions Inc unit and expects to make an announcement in the fourth quarter.

In the third quarter, it closed on the previously announced sales of its Unarco Commercial Products, Leavitt Tube and Home Products divisions. UNR, through its ROHN Division, makes and installs towers, shelters, cabinets and mounts for the telecommunications industry.
Earlier, it reported third quarter earnings from continuing oprerations of $0.11 a share, up from $0.09 a year ago.
